objective: Implement deterministic trade-print flow intelligence with explicit aggressor-classification provenance, classified buy/sell flow, Delta and CVD while preventing quote/tick proxies or provider-scoped Forex flow from being overstated as true consolidated market flow.
scope: Define governed trade-print source kinds for venue, broker and ECN trade prints
Define aggressor-classification methods for native flag, quote test, tick rule and unclassified flow
Enforce point-in-time quote-test context with no future quote leakage
Compute deterministic classified buy/sell volume, unclassified volume, Delta and CVD
Require explicit CVD starting state and contiguous sequence in the reference implementation
Calculate classified coverage and size-weighted classification confidence
Require spot-FX trade flow to remain provider/broker/ECN scoped
Reject quote updates and tick-volume proxies as trade prints
out_of_scope: Order Book, spread, depth or imbalance implementation (P09-D)
Funding, Open Interest, liquidation or crowding models (P09-F)
Signal fusion, calibrated trade probability, Risk approval or broker/exchange execution
Fabricating trade flow from quote updates or tick volume
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P09 trade-flow source
Policy rejects quote updates/tick-volume proxies as trade prints
Spot-FX trade prints are provider/broker/ECN scoped and global/consolidated claims fail closed
Native aggressor flags retain explicit provenance
Quote-test classification cannot consume future quote context
Tick-rule classification is deterministic and point-in-time
Unknown classification remains UNKNOWN and does not enter Delta
Delta equals classified buy volume minus classified sell volume
CVD equals explicit starting state plus deterministic Delta
CVD reference stream fails closed on sequence gaps or mixed streams
Classification coverage and weighted confidence are deterministic
Trade/classification/snapshot contracts expose no order or recommendation authority
P09-B evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No broker/exchange execution adapter is imported
No credential or network access is required
No quote/tick proxy is transformed into a synthetic trade print
rollback: Revert P09-B trade-flow module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P09-A remains canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Delta/CVD point-in-time and sequence invariants enforced
Forex/provider-scope and quote/tick non-trade boundaries enforced
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
